integrity: The proof gives a complete subgroup-type classification, an exact cyclic-subgroup partner count, and symbolic comparisons of all five resulting values. The included replay independently constructs three finite semidirect products and evaluates \(HK=KH\) for every ordered pair of cyclic subgroups. The known literature gap is taken from the published final version of the motivating paper; the earliest public-source date is the earlier arXiv release of the same work.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a faithful Frobenius action of \(C_{pq}\) on \(C_r\).
The complement has exactly two distinct prime factors.
The result does not classify all finite groups with three or four nonnormal subgroup-conjugacy classes.
An equivalent calculation could exist under ZM-group or subgroup-permutability terminology not exposed by indexed searches.
title: Five relative cyclic subgroup commutativity degrees for \(C_r\rtimes C_{pq}\)
